title: Correction to: Scalable kernel balancing weights in a nationwide observational study of hospital profit status and heart attack outcomes
content: This is a correction to: Kwangho Kim, Bijan A Niknam, José R Zubizarreta, Scalable kernel balancing weights in a nationwide observational study of hospital profit status and heart attack outcomes, Biostatistics, Volume 25, Issue 3, July 2024, Pages 736–753, https://doi.org/10.1093/biostatistics/kxad032
